text:
julian: Heads-up — we're seeing a small spike of customers who can't claim the free trial because card-on-file flow drops into a 3DS challenge and the issuer cancels it. Trial grant ultimately fails with a payment_method_required error. Example PI: pi_1HtYzX... (EU region). Can payments take a look?
anya: Thanks for flagging. Do we have a full API response / logs for one of the failures? Also prod-only or repro in sandbox? :thinking: 
julian: Repro'd in prod and one report from a customer in UK. Here's the error payload we logged (redacted):
```
{
  "error": {
    "type": "payment_error",
    "code": "trial_grant_failed",
    "message": "payment_method_required",
    "payment_intent": "pi_1HtYzX...",
    "last_payment_error": {
      "type": "card_error",
      "code": "authentication_required",
      "message": "3DS challenge requested",
      "decline_code": "issuer_challenge_cancelled"
    }
  }
}
```
sam: Noted. Stripe webhooks show payment_intent.status -> requires_action then later canceled/failed? stripe-bot: webhook: payment_intent.updated id=pi_1HtYzX... status=requires_action -> action: use_stripe_sdk -> later: status=requires_payment_method (canceled by issuer).
kevin: Could be issuer-side cancellations for certain banks. Any pattern on card BINs or card networks (Visa vs Mastercard)?
julian: Mostly Visa UK debit so far, but small sample. Customer says the 3DS modal briefly appears then the issuer's app returns 'challenge_cancelled' without user input sometimes.
anya: Ok — two immediate asks: (1) support: provide the full payment_intent id + customer id + browser/OS screenshots (if any) and we can escalate to payments-ops/stripe. (2) workarounds: we can manually grant trial credits for impacted customers while we investigate.
sam: Agreed. For manual grants: admin -> Credits -> Create grant -> amount X -> note '3DS issuer cancel workaround'. I'll do one for the EU customer if you confirm cust id. :thumbsup:
julian: Cust id 94215-EU, please proceed. Also capture repro steps: I was able to reproduce by creating a trial via POST /v1/trials with a new card token and completing checkout in Chrome 118. Sequence: create payment_intent -> redirect to stripe confirm -> stripe SDK triggers 3DS -> issuer returns challenge_cancelled -> payment_intent becomes requires_payment_method -> trial grant API returns 402 and message 'payment_method_required'.
anya: Good repro notes. I'll open a ticket with Stripe support and attach logs + sample payment_intent + timestamps. payments-ops, can you review for possible gateway routing changes or recent config flips? @payments-ops
payments-ops: We're on it. Quick question: are we forcing 3DS for all EU transactions via SCA policy or only when Stripe asks? If we're forcing, that could cause double-challenge issues.
kevin: We haven't toggled any global SCA overrides recently. I'll double-check config and the rollout flags around gateway/region specific routing.
sam: In the meantime, ops note — customers impacted can be served via manual credit grant. Also consider fallback: if payment_intent ends with requires_payment_method after issuer cancel, we could auto-offer a 'retry with new card' UI instead of blocking trial; but that's a UI change.
julian: Proceeded with manual grant for 94215-EU and sent the user confirmation. I'll paste the grant id here once visible.
anya: Thanks. When you open the Stripe ticket, please request issuer logs for that card network and ask whether the bank is auto-cancelling challenges (some issuers signal fraud protection). Also include the user agent and the sequence IDs.
julian: Grant created id=grant_2026_94215, user notified. I'll add full logs to the ticket and link here. Keeping thread open until Stripe responds.
payments-ops: We'll follow up with a short RCA if we find routing/config cause. For tracking: creating internal incident ST-987 to collect examples.
julian: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll ping if the customer reports recurrence. :raised_hands:
